props.text: Two days of fermentation, baked dark.
Laminated over three days. Out at seven, gone by nine.
Baked through the morning, so there is always a warm one.
Anything for the weekend is mixed on Thursday night.
We do not deliver. The bread is better if it does not travel.
No deposit, but tell us if plans change.

items: No. One oven, one bench, too much flour in the air to promise it.
Can I order a whole batch?
Yes, for collection. Tell us two days ahead and we will put it aside.
Three, and we are not looking for a fourth this year.

props.text: Tell us by Thursday and it will be waiting, warm, at six.
